log.note: Bootstrap. Spec + immutable plan frozen. Scaffold staged. Awaiting first-push human clearance (Rule 8).

STEP 0 DONE. Kicked off manually (bridge up, neil-cipher authed w/ workflow scope). gh repo create neil-cipher/sketchflow --public --push; commit 22db207 as neil-cipher <295313991+...>; GitHub Actions CI SUCCESS 14s. Next: step 1 (synthetic Zipfian generator + exact baseline).

STEP 1 DONE inline (user: build every day, no date-waiting). Zipfian stream + ExactCounter + 4 tests; commit 3a8d5a1; CI green 12s. GENTLE date-gating REMOVED from the job. Page redesigned: Ansh-style step-by-step build log w/ badges + commands; bullets-only Explainer.

STEP 2 DONE. Tabulation hashing (Zobrist 1970; Patrascu&Thorup J.ACM 2012), k independent seedable functions; fairness gates (uniform chi2 + independence). Tests caught a py3.11 tuple-seed TypeError pre-push. Commit 7b1ca0a; CI green 17s. Next: step 3 Bloom warm-up.

STEP 3 DONE. BloomFilter on step-2 HashFamily; gates: zero false negatives (absolute) + measured FPR vs analytic (1-e^{-kn/m})^k (Bloom, CACM 1970). 11 tests green. Commit 3208dae; CI 12s. Next: step 4 Bloom sizing calculator.

STEP 4 DONE. size_bloom(n, target_fpr) -> (m,k): m=ceil(-n ln p/ln^2 2), best-of-floor/ceil k, plus promise-keeping m-bump (k-rounding left analytic 0.01004>0.01 - a sizing calculator must deliver its promise exactly). Gate: analytic <= target exactly + measured FPR within 3-sigma on 50k probes. Commit ad72e7c.

STEP 5 DONE. CountMinSketch(width,depth,seed) on the step-2 HashFamily: depth x width counter matrix, weighted add, row_values. Gate: never-undercount invariant for every key of a 10k Zipfian stream vs ExactCounter under heavy collisions (width 256/8). 20 tests green. Commit e2df3f4, CI 19s. Next: step 6 min-query + eps/delta sizing -> first green tag.

STEP 6 DONE. query()=min(row_values) + size_cms(eps,delta)->(ceil(e/eps),ceil(ln(1/delta))). Gate: per-key failure rate ≤ δ across 300 seeds on 10k Zipfian stream (top-10 heavy hitters each checked). 28 tests green. Commit 1e6bae1, CI 34s. Tag green-sketchflow-1 cut (7 green steps 0-6). Next: step 7 memory accounting + serialize/deserialize.

STEP 7 DONE. bytes_used() via recursive sys.getsizeof (honest Python overhead) + to_bytes()/from_bytes() compact binary serialization (24-byte header + depth*width*8 counters). Gate: bytes_used == independent measurement; round-trip preserves every query and row_values; blob size == 24+d*w*8; corrupt blobs raise ValueError. 38 tests green. Commit 9912643, CI 35s. Next: step 8, CMS inner-product / join-size estimate.

STEP 8 DONE. inner_product(other) = min over rows of row-wise dot product (Cormode & Muthukrishnan 2005, Section 3). Validates dimension+seed match. Gate: 200 seeds, two 5k Zipfian streams, violation rate (est - true > ε·N_a·N_b) ≤ 3·δ. Also: never undercounts, symmetric, self-join ≈ L2², disjoint streams bounded, weighted adds correct. 11 new tests, 49 total green. Commit 51397cc, CI 52s. Next: step 9, conservative-update CMS.

STEP 9 DONE. ConservativeUpdateCMS subclass: overrides add() to only bump counters at or below the current minimum estimate (Estan & Varghese, SIGCOMM 2002, §4.2). Gate: for every key on a 10k Zipfian stream, CU estimate ≤ plain-CMS estimate AND CU estimate ≥ true count (never undercounts). Also: total CU overestimation strictly < plain CMS (by >20%), weighted adds correct, inherited inner_product/serialize/bytes_used all work, round-trip preserves state. 12 new tests, 61 total green. Commit 604496b, CI 54s. Next: step 10, Space-Saving top-k.

STEP 10 DONE. SpaceSaving(k) — bounded-memory heavy hitter tracker: at most k monitored counters; when full, evicts the minimum-count entry and the newcomer inherits evicted_count+1 (Metwally, Agrawal & El Abbadi, ICDT 2005). Gate: on Zipfian streams with heavy hitters above the N/k threshold, every such key is present in the monitored set; top-k keys match the exact baseline; monitored estimates are always ≥ true counts (overestimate). Also: eviction mechanics, weighted adds, k=1 edge case, capacity never exceeded, tie-breaking deterministic. 19 new tests, 80 total green. Commit 1b8eb2b, CI 54s. Next: step 11, Space-Saving min-heap + hash index for O(log k) update.

STEP 11 DONE. SpaceSaving internals upgraded to min-heap (heapq) + hash index for O(log k) add() — same external API, same results, faster at large k. Heap entries are [count, seq, key] lists; seq monotonic for FIFO tie-breaking; _index dict maps key→entry for O(1) lookup. Bump = update count in-place + sift-down; eviction = overwrite root + sift-down. _assert_heap_invariant() verifies heap property + index↔counters consistency. Gate: all step-10 behavioral tests still pass (guarantee, overestimate, eviction, top-k ordering); heap invariant holds after every mutation pattern (inserts, bumps, evictions, weighted, k=1); throughput at k=2000 stays >15% of k=50 (O(log k) scaling confirmed). 16 new tests, 96 total green. Commit 139b17b, CI 53s. Next: step 12, CMS + Space-Saving combined engine.

STEP 12 DONE. SketchEngine class in engine.py — composes CMS (or CU-CMS) + SpaceSaving into a single-pass analytics engine. Auto-sizes CMS from (ε,δ) via size_cms(). API: add(key), estimate(key) → CMS query, heavy_hitters(n) → Space-Saving top-k keys with CMS-estimated counts (tighter than raw SS counts), summary(). Supports conservative=True for CU-CMS variant. Gate: end-to-end on Zipfian streams, engine top-10 matches exact top-10 across 10 seeds; CMS estimates used (not SS counts); CU mode reduces overestimation; totals in sync across CMS+SS; weighted adds; edge cases (empty, single, k=1); validation. 18 new tests, 114 total green. Commit 099e86f, CI 50s. Phase P3 complete. Next: step 13, benchmark harness v1 (Phase P4).

STEP 13 DONE. bench.py benchmark harness v1 — runs seeded Zipfian streams through CMS, CU-CMS, Engine, Engine-CU; measures per-key error (mean/max/p99 absolute, mean relative) and memory (bytes_used, baseline_bytes, ratio) against ExactCounter ground truth; writes report/results.csv. CLI: PYTHONPATH=src python -m sketchflow.bench. First run (50k stream, 3 epsilons, 4 variants = 12 rows): CU-CMS halves mean error vs plain CMS; at ε=0.001 sketch memory exceeds dict baseline (honest Python overhead). 14 new tests, 128 total green. Commit 0bd3355, CI 44s. Phase P4 started. Next: step 14, accuracy-vs-memory sweep (vary width/depth, plot error decay via matplotlib).

STEP 14 DONE. sweep.py sweeps ε over two orders of magnitude (0.1→0.0005, 8 points × 4 variants = 32 rows → report/sweep.csv). plot.py reads CSV and generates report/accuracy_vs_memory.png via matplotlib (headless Agg backend): two log-log panels (mean error & max error vs sketch memory), four lines per panel (CMS, CU-CMS, Engine, Engine-CU). Gate: `PYTHONPATH=src python -m sketchflow.plot` regenerates the PNG from CSV in one command. Key finding visualised: CU-CMS halves mean error at every memory point; error decays ~linearly on log-log as ε shrinks. CI fix: added matplotlib to pip install in ci.yml. 15 new tests, 143 total green. Commits d12a237+f1d955c, CI 67s. Next: step 15, HUMAN fetch CIC-IDS-2017 CSV.
